title: 数组中的字符串匹配
summary: 返回 words 中是另一个不同单词子字符串的所有单词。
insight: 数据规模允许枚举有序单词对；若 i≠j 且 words[j] 包含 words[i]，就把 words[i] 加入答案一次。
pitfalls: 同一单词即使被多个字符串包含也只返回一次

solutions.title: 两两包含检查
solutions.idea: 为每个候选寻找任意包含它的其他单词。
steps: 内层遍历 j!=i，检查 words[j].contains(words[i])
一旦命中加入答案并结束该候选内层循环

code.java: class Solution { public List<String> stringMatching(String[] words){List<String> answer=new ArrayList<>();for(int i=0;i<words.length;i++)for(int j=0;j<words.length;j++)if(i!=j&&words[j].contains(words[i])){answer.add(words[i]);break;}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun stringMatching(words:Array<String>):List<String>{val answer=mutableListOf<String>();for(i in words.indices)for(j in words.indices)if(i!=j&&words[j].contains(words[i])){answer.add(words[i]);break};return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: vector<string> stringMatching(vector<string>& words){vector<string> answer;for(int i=0;i<(int)words.size();++i)for(int j=0;j<(int)words.size();++j)if(i!=j&&words[j].find(words[i])!=string::npos){answer.push_back(words[i]);break;}return answer;} };
